author: ToHubLab
name: Verification
short: User verification with math & text challenges
description: Verifies new users via a button or reaction, sends a short math or text challenge, and grants a role. Includes a full setup wizard, reaction emoji selection, auto-cleanup, lockout system, and an interactive management menu.
install_msg:
🐙 Thank you for installing **Verification** by ToHubLab!

**Features:**
• ⚙️ Interactive 4-step setup wizard
• 🔘 Button mode — users verify via a button
• 💬 Reaction mode — use an existing message with a custom emoji
• 🧮 Math & text challenges (randomized)
• 🎭 Auto role assignment on success
• ⏳ 3-strike lockout system with progress bar
• 🧹 Auto-cleanup of setup & status messages
• 🎨 Choose from 24 standard reaction emojis
• 📊 Live status menu with emoji/message/reset controls

**Quick start:**
`[p]verifysetup start` — run the setup wizard
`[p]verifymenu` — open the management menu

**Requirements:**
• `Manage Roles`, `Add Reactions`, `Read Message History`
• The verification role must be **below** the bot's highest role

Join our Discord for support & updates:
http://discord.finn-bot.rf.gd
